## Summary

Part 1 of the pre-split BL-37 package (ADR-0214's 34 deferred Stage-4/5/6
stage-blocking questions): briefs the leading seventeen OQs by register
order — OQ-116/177/242/246/368/378/379/380/381/386/388/392/400/401/405/
413/417 — in the new brief file
`docs/build/planning/round4-bl37-adr-0214-briefs.md`. The head
`Operator act: "adopt all except: <ids>"` line is positioned to cover
both parts; R4.13a appends part 2 (OQ-418 … OQ-458) below the marked
site. The ticket never rules: every row is a FINAL *proposed* disposition

R4.12). CF-476/CF-487 get package-side evidence paragraphs + register
pointer notes for R4.15's adjudication brief — pointed, never
pre-answered.

Highlights: OQ-116 — the landed consent pair answers "both":
declaration carries `model_io_intercept`, the manifest's granted set
consents (`ConsentMissing` at export); owner = the run's human
principal. OQ-177 — recording act: ADR-0306 D1 is the determining
landed ADR (the `ApproverGrant` record confers; delegation-by-grant;
seven-class sum unchanged). OQ-242 — landed `ACP_VERSION = "0.1.0"` +
`v1-compat` era negotiation is the pin; ADR-0197's `zero_uses` + window
is the removal test. OQ-246 — `allow_lease` → `ApprovalLease` is the
ledgered amendment form; ACP lowering + named `hh-edge-loss/1` losses
(ADR-0306 D3). OQ-368 — 90-day `max_age` + `revalidation.schedule`
adopted; re-pin entry test preserved verbatim. OQ-378 — unconditional
lift; the passing-oracle arm resolves to the same class. OQ-379 —
landed `ProcessPlacement` sum answers the disjunction: `in_environment`
via the helper's exec channel is the C1 default. OQ-380 — stale =
`version_identity` mismatch only; stale annotates (`stale_dimensions`),
never a silent downgrade. OQ-381 — deadlines stay adapter data;
`ensure_terminal` synthesizes `unobserved`. OQ-386 — attended defaults
stay `{allow_once, deny_once}`; `NarrowingHint` = suggestion requiring
explicit `allow_lease` (ADR-0170). OQ-388 — pointer only; R4.15 owns
the ratification proposal (DF-S4.13-1). OQ-392 — per-kind defaults =
declared `SinkPolicy` data over the `{accounting}` floor; hosted
`model_io` rides the OQ-116 consent pair. OQ-400 — the `serve_bundle`
arm landed (ADR-0318): `connection_info` into `HostedRunSpec`; the
server is service-owned, `close(session)` releases via the handle
lifecycle. OQ-401 — (c) loopback-only with the ADR-0301 D3 ordered
gate; a fourth binding only by its own ADR. OQ-405 — `allow_pattern` =
`allow_lease{pattern}`; attach viewers read `list_leases`. OQ-413 —
validator-at-`stop` + default `none`. OQ-417 — kernel constants +
`MessagingPolicy` data; both fork arms rejected.

No `descope-by-ADR` or `needs-code-leg` rows; no new CF rows
(CF-476/CF-487 are already-registered rows pointed at R4.15, not new
divergences).
